survey: DJ controller with headphones lying on the floor in front of it, to the right. Controller body: a rounded rectangular deck on short round feet; the front-left, back-left and back-right feet are visible and touch the floor. Two jog-wheel platters, one on each side, set into the top face; they match each other and their oval shape is consistent with perspective. Centre mixer section: two channel faders in two parallel slots, and a raised strip above with three knobs. Three rows of pads: left and right each have yellow, green and magenta; the centre has small magenta, wide magenta, small magenta. The layout is symmetric and every pad sits flush in the deck. Headphones: the headband arches up with a light-blue inner cushion. Its right end goes into a yoke block attached to the front ear cup, whose outer side faces the camera. Its left end goes down behind the back ear cup, whose cushion side faces the camera, so the two cups face each other as real headphones do. Both cups rest on the floor. Neither the headphones nor the controller has a cable, an acceptable simplification (wireless headphones; power and audio cables left out).
